theorems.name: Submission.rsd_cmr_regularSet_transfer
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U V : Set (Euclid P)) (hVU : V ⊆ U) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (T₀ : GeometricCurrentOn V n) (c : ℤ) (y : Euclid P), c ≠ 0 → (∀ ω : TestFormOn V n, T (testFormOnInclusion hVU n ω) = (c : ℝ) * T₀ ω) → y ∈ T.support → y ∈ regularSet T₀ → y ∈ regularSet T
